about: The menu music lab's candidates (docs/design/mock/menu-music-lab.html): free 8-bit tracks a GPL-3.0 project may ship on its card image and in its public repository. Each source is the exact file downloaded, by its SHA-256. tools/bgm-tracks.py lab makes the lab's audio from these; the picks go to res/bgm/tracks.json.

tracks.title: Napping on a Cloud
tracks.author: congusbongus
tracks.style: Chill, happy chiptune made in MilkyTracker. Rendered here from the author's own module file, so it has none of the 64 kbps download's blur.

tracks.title: Apple Cider
tracks.author: Zane Little Music
tracks.style: Cozy autumn chiptune in a 16-bit console style. Tags on its page: cozy, cute, SNES.
tracks.notice: This song (and everything else I make) is royalty-free!

tracks.title: Hush Hamlet
tracks.author: Zane Little Music
tracks.style: Quiet village theme from the chiptune collection Another Bag of Chips. Tags on its page: cozy, relaxing, calm.

tracks.title: Truth

tracks.notice: Credits are NOT mandatory, but I'm curious to know what you will do with it, so don't hesitate to share the project that uses it :)

tracks.title: Canon in D
tracks.author: ctske
tracks.work: Canon and Gigue in D, Johann Pachelbel (1653-1706)
tracks.style: An 8-bit transcription in FamiTracker (2A03, the NES's own voices).
tracks.notice: This is about as public domain as public domain gets, so no credit is necessary. If you want to give credit anyway, you can call it "an 8-bit transcription by Ctske of Johann Pachelbel's Canon and Gigue for 3 violins and basso continuo".
